sn35.95:1.1: atha kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.95:1.2: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.95:2.1: etthadāni māluṅkyaputta, kiṃ dahare bhikkhū vakkhāma,
sn35.95:2.2: yatra hi nāma tvaṃ bhikkhu jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto saṅkhittena ovādaṃ yācasīti.
sn35.95:3.1: kiñcāpahaṃ bhante, jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto.
sn35.95:3.2: desetu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ, desetu sugato saṅkhittena dhammaṃ, appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ. appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti.
sn35.95:4.2: ye te cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā adiṭṭhā adiṭṭhapubbā, na ca passasi, na ca te hoti. passeyyanti, atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:5.1: ye te sotaviññeyyā saddā assutā assutapubbā, na ca suṇāsi, na ca te hoti suṇeyyanti, atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:6.1: ye te ghānaviññeyyā gandhā aghāyitā aghāyitapubbā. na ca ghāyasi, na ca te hoti ghāyeyyanti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:7.1: ye te jivhāviññeyyā rasā asāyitā asāyitapubbā, na ca sāyasi, na ca te hoti sāyeyyanti, atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:8.1: ye te kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā asamphuṭṭhā asamphuṭṭhapubbā na ca phusasi, na ca te hoti phuseyyanti, atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:9.1: ye te manoviññeyyā dhammā aviññātā aviññātapubbā, na ca vijānāsi, na ca te hoti vijāneyyanti, atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn35.95:10.1: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
sn35.95:10.2: yato kho te māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati,
sn35.95:10.7: tato tvaṃ māluṅkyaputta, nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena.
sn35.95:11.1: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
sn35.95:36.1: imassa kho’haṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.95:36.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ māluṅkyaputta, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn35.95:41.1: imassa kho māluṅkyaputta mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
sn35.95:42.1: atha kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn35.95:42.2: atha kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn35.95:42.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn35.95:42.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā māluṅkyaputto arahataṃ ahosīti.
